records.description: The list of compute usage records in the requested time duration.

nextPageToken.description: The token to use when requesting the next set of results. If not present, there are no additional results.

ComputeUsageRecord.description: Record of compute usage values aggregated hourly.

quantityType.description: Type of usage by the cluster (Eg: INSTANCE_USAGE, COMPUTE_USAGE).

cloudProvider.description: Cloud Provider on which cluster is running.

usageStartTimestamp.description: Timestamp of start of the usage.

usageEndTimestamp.description: Timestamp of end of the usage.

quantity.description: Quantity of usage of the cluster.

grossCharge.description: Number of credits consumed by this usage.

listRate.description: Rate in credits at which usage is charged for given cluster type, instance type and cloud provider.

hours.description: Total number of hours for which instances were running.

instanceType.description: Type of instance of the cluster.

instanceCount.description: Total number of instances in the cluster which were in use.

userTags.description: The tags assigned to a cluster. The format of this is a map serialized into a string as json. e.g.:  "tags": "{\"key1\":\"value1\",\"key2\":\"value2\"}"

clusterTemplate.description: The template with which the cluster is created.
